arStrings.szText:
Cold Mages occasionally cast a blizzard that deals {c_number}{payload:BLIZZARD}{/c} Cold damage over {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} seconds and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_9}%{/c} every second.

Enemies damaged by Cold Mages are made {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} seconds.
